exposure: Healthcare providers' perceptions of childbirth education classes
outcome: Mothers feeling in control during pregnancy, birth, and postpartum
cohort: The participants were 15 healthcare providers (physicians, nurses, and educators) from three government hospitals in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia.
finding: Childbirth education programs boost maternal health and facilitate a more positive delivery experience, enabling low-risk mothers to feel in control during pregnancy, birth, and postpartum.
cross-section timing: N/A (Qualitative study focusing on current perceptions)
